title: Chart Forge Project
description: One authoring project as the Editor sees it: which audio, which analysis and which chart belong together, plus the Editor's own working state. A project associates documents; it is not itself an analysis or a chart. Analysis and chart data may be referenced by file or embedded inline. Referencing is the expected default because analysis documents can be large; inline embedding exists so that a small, self-contained project can be moved as a single file.

version.description: Version of the Project document format (semantic versioning).

audio.description: The audio the project is built around. Always a reference; audio is never embedded.

path.description: Path to the audio file, relative to this document unless absolute.

sha256.description: Hash of the audio file, so the Editor can warn when the audio changed after analysis.

analysis.description: The Analysis document used as the guide layer. Absent when the audio has not been analysed yet.

chart.description: The Chart document being authored. Absent for a project where authoring has not started.

editor.description: Editor working state. Purely a convenience for restoring a session: it must never affect the meaning of the analysis or the chart, and any Editor must work correctly when this is missing or contains keys it does not recognise.

viewportStartSec.description: Left edge of the timeline view, in seconds.

snap.description: Grid snapping used when placing notes.

division.description: Beat subdivision to snap to, e.g. 4 for sixteenth notes in 4/4.

layers.description: Visibility of the guide layers drawn on the timeline. Open vocabulary of layer ids such as waveform, spectrogram, beatGrid, onsets, events, stems.

documentRef.description: Either a reference to a document stored in a separate file, or that document embedded inline. Exactly one of the two forms.

path.description: Path to the document, relative to this project file unless absolute.

sha256.description: Hash of the referenced document, so the Editor can detect that it changed outside the project.

data.description: The embedded document, which must itself satisfy the corresponding schema (analysis.schema.json or chart.schema.json). It is not re-validated here so that this schema stays independent of the other two.
